enriched.title: Verbos Irregulares e Vocabulário de Negócios
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso de verbos irregulares no inglês, incluindo conjugações e vocabulário relacionado a negócios e economia. Também oferece dicas de pronúncia e explicações gramaticais sobre o uso de artigos definidos com nomes próprios.

vocabulary.definition: To exchange a product or service for money.
examples: He sells cars for a living.
She sold her old phone last week.

vocabulary.definition: The act of selling something or the amount sold.
examples: The store is having a big sale this weekend.
The sale of the house was finalized yesterday.

vocabulary.definition: To allow liquid, gas, or information to escape accidentally.
examples: The pipe is leaking water.
The document leak caused a scandal.
The economy stagnated during the crisis.
Her career has stagnated lately.

vocabulary.definition: To perceive sound with the ears.
examples: I heard a strange noise last night.
She hears the birds singing every morning.

vocabulary.definition: A formal talk given to an audience.
examples: The president gave a speech about the economy.
Her speech was very inspiring.
She said she would call later.
What did he say about the project?
I saw him at the park yesterday.
Can you see the bird in the tree?

vocabulary.definition: The act of using goods or services.
examples: Energy consumption has increased in recent years.
The consumption of sugary drinks is harmful to health.

vocabulary.definition: A lack of equality between people or groups.
examples: Income inequality is a major issue in many countries.
They are working to reduce gender inequality.

vocabulary.definition: Money owed to another person or organization.
examples: He is trying to pay off his student debt.
The company is struggling with a large amount of debt.

grammar.topic: Uso de artigos com nomes próprios
grammar.explanation: No inglês, não utilizamos o artigo definido 'the' antes de nomes próprios.
rules: Não use 'the' com nomes próprios como Satya Nadella.
Use apenas o nome sem o artigo.
examples: Satya Nadella is the CEO of Microsoft.
I met John at the conference.
commonMistakes: The Satya Nadella is a great leader.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugue o verbo 'see' no Simple Past.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 'See' no Simple Past é conjugado como 'saw'.

practiceQuestions.question: Traduza para inglês: 'Ele ouviu o discurso ontem.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: Usamos 'heard' como o passado de 'hear' e 'speech' para 'discurso'.

culturalNotes: Satya Nadella é o CEO da Microsoft e um exemplo de liderança global.
O uso de 'fiat money' refere-se a sistemas econômicos modernos baseados em moedas sem valor intrínseco.
studyTips: Pratique a pronúncia de palavras com sons difíceis como 'debt'.
Revise verbos irregulares frequentemente para memorização eficaz.
originalExamples: Satya Nadella (not 'the' Satya Nadella). (Satya Nadella, não 'o Satya Nadella.')
